extraction.issue_description: Hello, this is not a complaint. I'd just like some clarification before I upgrade. If I move from the Standard plan to Business Plus mid-cycle, am I charged the full month or is it pro-rated? And does the seat count reset on the upgrade date or on my usual billing date? Thanks very much for your help.
extraction.resolution_provided: Billing team confirmed that mid-cycle upgrades are pro-rated and that the seat count resets on the existing billing date. This was sent to the customer on 26 March.
